title: Outbox worker
conditions: Rows in notification_outbox with status QUEUED
Attempt count under the ladder cap
actions: Claim a batch under an advisory lock
Send through the channel adapter
Write delivery row with the idempotency key
guard: One unique idempotency key per send. A second worker claiming the same row is refused by the lock, which is the defect that produced 1,892 sends from 77 keys.

title: Monthly matrix dispatch
conditions: Branch matrix complete at all five levels
No dispatch row already sent for this month marker
actions: Build one dispatch row per branch
Queue to the outbox with month-keyed idempotency
guard: A branch with an incomplete matrix is held out, not sent to. Held branches are listed with their reason rather than silently skipped.

title: Escalation chase
conditions: Escalation open past its level TAT
Next level exists in the matrix
actions: Raise the next escalation level
Write ESCALATED with a level-scoped idempotency key
guard: hash(assignment, cycle, level, trigger) is unique, so a re-run cannot double-escalate.

title: Matrix completeness chase
conditions: Branch active for a live client
actions: Write the gap to the branch record
Start or continue the P-06 14-day clock
guard: The clock is per branch and per level, so fixing one level does not reset the others.

title: Penalty sweep
conditions: No instance already raised for this rule and period
actions: Raise a penalty instance at the amount in force on the cutoff date
Post to the ledger
notifies: HR for payroll rules, Finance for P-06
guard: Amount is captured at raise time. Changing a rule later never restates a penalty already raised.
blocked_why: Four penalty amounts are still placeholders. The sweep runs and reports but will not post until they are finalised.

title: Daily count lock
actions: Lock the day
Mark it missed if empty
guard: A locked day can only be reopened by HR with a reason, so the count cannot be back-filled quietly.

title: Auto-close sweep
actions: Close the escalation
Stop every clock
guard: Refuses to close while any requirement is incomplete or any request is open.

title: Monthly summary pack
actions: Assemble target vs achieved per person
Attach attributes and FYI notes
Publish the review pack
notifies: Every chair holder and their manager
guard: Reads the roll-up, never the transaction tables, so a review pack cannot slow the tool at month end.

title: Appreciation nudge
conditions: A person met target every day last week
actions: Draft an appreciation note for the manager to send
guard: Drafted, never auto-sent. Praise from a robot is worth nothing.

title: Note classification
actions: Classify as an Attribute with a heading, or as FYI
File into the monthly review
notifies: Author, so they can correct the filing
guard: The author can always overrule the classification, and the original text is kept verbatim beside it.

title: Roll-up rebuild
actions: Rebuild KPI roll-ups per chair, branch, region and company
guard: Reconciles to source counts and refuses to publish on a variance, rather than publishing a wrong number.

title: Claim reminder
conditions: Claim submitted and unapproved past 3 days
actions: Remind the approver
notifies: Approver, then their manager at day 7
guard: Escalates once, then stops. A reminder loop is what filled the old audit log with noise.

title: TAT resolution and snapshot
conditions: Client, verification type, geography and quantity known
actions: Score every matching rule by specificity
Snapshot the winning TAT onto the instance
Write the full rule trace including runners-up
notifies: Assignor sees the resolved TAT before assigning
guard: Snapshotted. A rule change later never moves a clock that is already running.
blocked_why: Holiday calendars are empty. No TAT may be enforced until holidays are loaded for this and next financial year.

title: SLA status tick
actions: Set AT_RISK, then BREACHED
Write SLA_AT_RISK / SLA_BREACHED
guard: sla_status is an attribute, not a state. A breached assignment still shows its operator the correct next action.

title: Clock segment ledger
trigger_on: Any state change on an assignment
actions: Close the open segment with its business minutes
Open a new segment with state and attribution
notifies: Nobody — the ledger is the record
guard: A partial unique index allows exactly one open segment per instance, so overlap is impossible rather than unlikely.

title: RFI conditional pause
conditions: No pause already granted this cycle
Reason is in the pause-eligible set
actions: Credit up to 120 business minutes
Open a PAUSED segment attributed to the assignor
notifies: Assignee sees the decision and its arithmetic before submitting
guard: Shown before submission, so a pause is never a surprise and never a free extension.

title: Sub-TAT timers
actions: Start the sub-TAT
Mark it breached on expiry
notifies: Assignor, then their manager on breach
guard: A sub-TAT breach escalates on the assignor side, so no strike can land on the assignee for that cycle.

title: Delay auto-accept
conditions: No auto-accept already used on this assignment
actions: Resolve AUTO_ACCEPTED
Attribute the minutes PENDING_REVIEW
Cap the extension at due + 12 business hours
notifies: Adds to the Confirm Attribution tray
guard: One auto-accept only. A second unreviewed delay escalates instead of self-approving, so silence never becomes a renewable extension.

title: Escalation ladder L1–L4
trigger_on: Breach, sub-TAT breach, or a manual raise
conditions: No instance with the same idempotency key
actions: Resolve the recipient
Insert the escalation
Hand to the outbox
guard: One adapter, one key. No routing logic lives inside the assignment workflow.

title: Hierarchy fallback
trigger_on: Escalation recipient not found in the matrix
conditions: Exact, then client+location, then location keys all missed
actions: Walk the assignee location’s org hierarchy
Deliver anyway
Write ESCALATION_FALLBACK_USED
guard: Never drops an escalation because configuration is incomplete.

title: CONFIG_GAP alert
conditions: A matrix key was genuinely missing
actions: Raise a CONFIG_GAP naming the exact missing key
guard: Names the key rather than saying “escalation failed”, so the gap is fixable in one action.

title: Strike generation
trigger_on: Nightly sweep under an advisory lock
conditions: No PENDING_REVIEW segment unresolved on that cycle
actions: Insert a strike_event with the location as at breach time
guard: Unique on (assignment, cycle, trigger). The same sweep running twice cannot produce a second strike.

title: Strike waiver
conditions: A strike exists on that cycle
actions: Set status WAIVED with a reason
Count the failure on the assignor quality KPI
guard: Waived, never deleted. The row stays visible as waived so the history is honest.

title: Priority score recompute
trigger_on: Every 10 minutes, and on any state change
actions: Recompute age, SLA pressure, escalation level, client tier and rework penalty
Bucket as Breach, Attention or Normal
guard: Operators read the bucket; the number only orders. A score nobody can explain is not a priority.

title: Control tower refresh
actions: Refresh the materialised assignment summary
guard: The tower reads the summary, never the transaction tables. Twelve live counts on every dashboard load is how you take the system down at 09:30.

title: Repeat Point ID triage
trigger_on: A Point ID already on record is keyed again
actions: Write a decision row with the system’s proposal
Hold the assignment in DRAFT with no clock
guard: Proposes, never applies. Undecided repeats are a queue with an owner rather than a silent backlog.

title: Duplicate check
conditions: Live attempt on the same point, or a fuzzy name-address-pincode match
actions: Refuse a second live assignment
Warn on a fuzzy match and require a reason
guard: An override is a row with an author and a reason, replacing the hand-maintained duplicate column.

title: Arbitration trigger
actions: Open arbitration with the lowest common manager
Lock both parties out of further disputes
guard: The arbiter is computed from the closure table, so it cannot be chosen to suit either side.

title: Mail budget guard
actions: Send, or hold in the outbox with a reason
notifies: Administrator when the reserve is touched
guard: 1,849 of the old system’s failures were quota exhaustion. The budget is a rule, not a hope.

title: Retry ladder
actions: Retry under a NEW idempotency key
Leave the old key failed in the ledger
guard: History shows one failure and one retry, never two sends.

title: Bounce flagging
conditions: Recipient is a client or branch contact
actions: Flag the contact on the branch record
Add a confirm-this-contact task to the next visit
guard: A bad address becomes fieldwork rather than a repeating failure.

title: Strike-3 warning ladder
trigger_on: Third active strike inside the rolling 90 days
actions: Generate the warning with its facts
Require acknowledgement
guard: The window is rolling and computed from events, so a strike ages out rather than being deleted.

title: Daily count reminder and lock
actions: Remind, then lock the day
guard: One reminder and one lock. Not a loop.

title: Target vs achieved roll-up
actions: Compute achieved and percentage per KPI
Roll up the chain
guard: Percentages are derived, never stored, so a corrected count corrects the roll-up.

title: AI note filing
actions: File as an Attribute with a heading, or as FYI
Show the source note beside it
guard: The author can always overrule it, and the original wording is never rewritten.

title: Monthly review assembly
actions: Assemble the review pack per person
guard: No individual is scored by a machine. The pack is evidence for a conversation.

title: Rule application on cutoff
actions: Raise an instance at the amount in force
guard: Amount captured at raise time.

title: P-06 matrix clock
actions: Raise the P-06 instance
guard: The clock is visible on the branch from day one, with days elapsed shown, so nobody is surprised at day 14.

title: Recovery routing
conditions: Rule is payroll or Finance recoverable
actions: Route P-01 to P-05 and P-07 to HR payroll
Route P-06 to Finance
guard: One route per rule. A penalty cannot be recovered twice.

title: Branch record write-back
conditions: Visit has contact or finding data
actions: Update branch manager and POC details
Append findings and pending issues
guard: The visit is the source of truth for contacts, which is what keeps the matrix current without a data-entry task.

title: RAG and ageing
actions: Recompute the branch RAG and ageing chip
State the reason for the colour
guard: A colour with no reason beside it is decoration. The reason is always rendered.

title: Collection commitment to FMEA
actions: Write a missed-commitment FMEA line against the client
guard: The commitment is captured at the visit, so the miss is evidenced rather than argued.

title: Satisfaction 1 raises an escalation
actions: Raise a service escalation automatically
notifies: Branch Manager, Regional Manager, Business Development
guard: A very dissatisfied client cannot be recorded and left alone.

title: Chair KPI inheritance
conditions: Effective-dated from the next cadence period
actions: Apply to everyone holding the chair
Leave the current period untouched
guard: Nobody is re-scored against a rule that moved mid-month.

title: Closure table rebuild
conditions: The move does not create a cycle
actions: Rebuild org_unit_closure in the same transaction
guard: My-team scope, escalation fallback and arbitration all read the new line immediately, so the three cannot disagree.

title: Vacancy surfacing
trigger_on: A holder leaves or a chair is created
actions: Mark the chair vacant with its owned processes named
guard: Unowned processes are shown rather than hidden, because a hidden vacancy is how work goes unowned.

title: Validate, preview, apply
conditions: Same four validation levels as manual entry
No error rows if all-or-nothing chosen
actions: Validate every row
Show valid, warning and error counts with the first 50 errors
Apply in one transaction
guard: Nothing is relaxed for a file. That is how the old datastore acquired 198,890 empty rows.

title: Dependency order
actions: Refuse with the missing dependency named
guard: Refused whole rather than half-applied.

title: Rollback snapshot
actions: Keep a snapshot
Allow a one-action reversal with a reason
guard: A reversal is a new event that supersedes the upload, so the history shows both.
